content: Xenni usin-dd yeryazen n Qaryat-Yaɛarim uca iwyen Ttabut n SIDI ɣarsen sennej. Nitni ssidfen tt di taddart n Abinadab, x tewrirt, uca ssqeddsen mmis Aliɛazar ḥima ad iḥḍa x Ttabut n SIDI.
Zeg wass nni imsar aqa Ttabut teqqim di Qaryat-Yaɛarim. Tuɣa ɛdun aṭṭas n wussan ařami ɛdun ɛicrin n iseggʷusa. Marra taddart n Israil tuyur awarni i SIDI, tᵉttcetca.

Xenni issiweř Camwil ɣar marra taddart n Israil, inna: “Mařa kenniw texsem ad dd-tdewřem ɣar SIDI s marra uř nwem, xenni nḍarem xawem irebbiten iɣriben zi řwesṭ nwem, uřa d ‘Ɛactarutin’, u arrem uř nwem ɣar SIDI, xedmem as i Netta weḥḥdes, xenni Netta ad kenniw ifekk zeg ufus n Ifilisṭiniyyen.”
Uca nḍaren ayt n Israil ‘Ibaɛlen’ d ‘Ɛactarutin’ uca ɛebden i SIDI weḥḥdes.
Inna Camwil: “Smunem marra Israil di Miṣfat, xenni necc ad ẓẓaǧeɣ i SIDI i kenniw.”
Munen di Miṣfa uca uymen aman, farrɣen ten zzat i wudem n SIDI. Deg wass nni ẓummen uca nnan din: “Aqa nexḍa ak-d SIDI!” Ammu i iḥkem Camwil ayt n Israil di Miṣfa.
Umi Ifilisṭiniyyen sřin, aqa ayt n Israil tuɣa munen di Miṣfat, ffɣen řbacat n tneddam n Ifilisṭiniyyen ḍidd i Israil. Řami sřin ayt n Israil i mana aya, ggʷeden nitni zeg Ifilisṭiniyyen.
Nnan ayt n Israil i Camwil: “War sbeddi s uřaɣi di ṭṭweɛ nneɣ i SIDI, AREBBI nneɣ, maḥend Netta ad aneɣ ifekk zeg ufus n Ifilisṭiniyyen.”
Xenni iksi Camwil ijj n izmar iṭṭeḍ u iqeddem i-t qaɛ d taɣarṣt n wecmaḍ i SIDI u Camwil iřaɣa ɣar SIDI di ṭṭweɛ n Israil u SIDI isřa as.

Umi iqeddem Camwil taɣarṣt n wecmaḍ, imsar, aqa usin-dd Ifilisṭiniyyen i umenɣi ak-d Israil. Uca isshemhem SIDI aṭṭas deg wass nni x Ifilisṭiniyyen, issarjef i-ten ařami ttwaɣeřben zzat i wudem n Israil.
Ffɣen yeryazen n Israil zi Miṣfa, ḍfaren Ifilisṭiniyyen uca wtin ten ař sadu Bayt-Kar.
Iksi Camwil ijj n weẓru, issbedd i-t jar Miṣfa d San. Netta igga as isem ‘Abin-Haɛizir’, inna: “Ař danita i d aneɣ iwca SIDI afus.”
Ammu i ttwasseḥqaren Ifilisṭiniyyen uca war udifen ca ɛad daxeř i iymiren n Israil, minzi tuɣa afus n SIDI ḍidd i Ifilisṭiniyyen marra ussan n Camwil.

Tineddam zi Ɛaqrun ař Jat i tuɣa ṭṭfen Ifilisṭiyyen zeg ayt n Israil, dewřent-dd ɣar Israil uca jjwayeh i ɣarsen dd-iqqnen, iqřeɛ i-tent Israil zeg ufus n Ifilisṭiniyyen uca idweř din řehna jar Israil d Imuriyyen.
Tuɣa Camwil d řqaḍi x Israil marra ussan n tudart nnes.
Aseggʷas x useggʷas tuɣa netta itteffeɣ, iggur di Bayt-Il d Jiljal d Miṣfa. Di marra imucan nni tuɣa netta d řqaḍi x Israil.
Awarni aya idweř netta ɣar Rama, maɣar dinni i tuɣa taddart nnes u dinni tuɣa netta d řqaḍi x Israil uca ibna dinni ijj n uɛalṭar i SIDI.

footnotes.text: Abin-Haɛizir- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘aẓru n uɛawen’ niɣ ‘aẓru n twiza’.
